answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 151232 Country: India Title: Please suggest any other unique girl name for my 1st newborn daughter. Question: Please suggest any other unique girl name for my 1st newborn daughter. Answer ID: 151232 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 855/797/SD=9/1438) Choose any name among the names of Sahabiyat for example, Aisha, Khadijah, Umaimah, Maria, Zainab, Ruqayyah etc. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
